title: Don't Forget To Breath
description: Always keep on breathing, and having a new challange of concentration.
body:

## Airmask
- allows you to breath without manual breathing, but only when you don't sprint
- helps you breathing

### Breathing
- breath with R
- max. to 5 lung-capacity
- you stop if you hold to long breath
